shots.name: fling-rows-now
shots.setup: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.acpmux-scroll'); if (!s) return; const step = () => { s.scrollTop = Math.max(0, s.scrollTop - s.clientHeight); if (s.scrollTop > 0) requestAnimationFrame(step); }; requestAnimationFrame(step); })()
